sentences.text: THIS WP IS FILED UNDER ARTICLES 226 AND 227 OF THE CONSTITUTION OF INDIA PRAYING TO DIRECTING THE RESPONDENTS TO CONSIDER AND TO DISPOSE OF THE APPLICATION DATED 17.12.2013, 03.07.2015, 29.06.2015 AND 29.06.2015 FILED UNDER SECTION 28(A)(1) OF LAND ACQUISITION ACT, 1894 VIDE ANNEXURE - A, B, C, D AND E AS EXPEDITIOUSLY AS POSSIBLE IN ACCORDANCE WITH LAW.

THIS W.P. COMING ON FOR PRELIMINARY HEARING,
THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER The short grievance of the Petitioners is as to non- consideration of their petition filed under Section 28A(1) of the erstwhile Land Acquisition Act, 1894 wherein they have sought for extension of the benefit of enhanced compensation granted to owners of the lands, that were part of the very same acquisition notification.

sentences.text: Learned AGA on request having appeared for the respondents opposes the petition contending that the grievance of the Petitioners cannot be considered in writ jurisdiction.

Having so contended,
he now graciously agrees to instruct his clients to look into grievance on the petitioner in accordance with law & in a time bound way; this is appreciable.
In view of the above, Writ Petition is disposed off, costs having been made easy.
Time for consideration of subject petition is eight weeks.
All contentions are kept open.
It is open to the answering Respondents to solicit any information or documents from the side of Petitioners subject to the rider that in the guise of such solicitation, delay shall not be brooked.
